title: Ep 36 - Amodei Says Slow Down, and the App Staging Empty Rooms for Ten Grand a Month
description: Anthropic's Dario Amodei calls for the AI industry to deliberately pace itself, OpenAI ships a plain-English data analyst inside ChatGPT Work, and Google widens Gemini's reach across Workspace. Plus a deep dive on IACrea, an AI room-staging tool for estate agents reportedly earning around ten thousand dollars a month, and a nineteenth straight quiet episode for EV-Partnerships' sports-venue charging gap.
